scope: Private PostgreSQL 18 schemas; genuine Cookie session HTTP handler, WebSocket transport, Owner and physical checkpoint; no browser, Next middleware, sidebar-link HTTP or production latency claim

counterSemantics.sql: Actual driver calls including transaction control and registered dedicated Owner clients; not a split of multi-statement strings
counterSemantics.pool: Runtime checkouts are booked at connect completion; the callsite diagnostic counts starts. Background work can cross these window boundaries; equality is not assumed.
counterSemantics.connections: peakConnections covers pooled leases only; pg_stat_activity samples include dedicated clients but are lower bounds, not an exact connection high-water mark
counterSemantics.cost: Callsite stack collection adds diagnostic overhead. Counts/windows are not a production or before-after latency benchmark.

memberSnapshotExplain.scope: actual Member snapshot SELECT during two original Cookie session requests in a private small fixture; extra EXPLAIN executes on its held connection; no latency or full-plan acceptance claim
